additionalWorkflows.assessment: Fresh model modality evidence; uploaded bytes pinned through accepted/unknown sends; file ranges revision-bound and untrusted; bounded output schema. Current targeted Linux attachment run passed 16 with its one Windows-only case skipped; platform skips are not successes.

additionalWorkflows.assessment: Exact pending request identity; available decisions; conservative selector-based permission grants preserve deny/read restrictions and scan-depth metadata while allowing category refusal. Bounded form validation, cancellation of unsupported extensions and no auto-approval. Permission regressions use JSON and fake-native responses, not downstream filesystem-enforcement acceptance.

additionalWorkflows.assessment: Native ancestry and canAcceptDirectInput govern controls. No nonexistent spawn RPC is invented; spawning remains model/native tools.

Remote environment registration is not an equivalent.

additionalWorkflows.assessment: Official codex mcp logout <NAME> is available to the operator in the managed native identity/HOME/CODEX_HOME, followed by app-server restart and status reread. No browser logout RPC exists; config disable/remove is not logout. Isolated no-credential fixture exit zero does not prove real token revocation.

additionalWorkflows.assessment: No web automation of these CLI commands. Policy checks/context exports and database migrations require deliberate operator workflow; NFS cutover requires coordination of all clients. Not silently represented by rollout/compress.
